migration_origin: Curated from V2.1 outfit ontology and Image Library outfit systems.
rules: Describe construction and layering before decorative adjectives.
Keep garment shaping separate from anatomy changes.
When history is active, era/role/occasion compatibility outranks generic fashion defaults.
When an outfit reference is active, preserve its silhouette/material logic but do not import the reference person's face or body.
Limit handheld props so each hand has a physically traceable job.
